rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for doing something angrily.

example.jyutping: ngo5 niu5 zyu6 naau6 zo2 keoi5 jat1 caan1

rows.note: Use this when the person is visibly furious or acting with strong anger, rather than merely annoyed.

example.english: They irately stormed into the room.
example.traditional: 佢怒氣沖沖咁衝入間房。
example.jyutping: keoi5 nou6 hei3 cung1 cung1 gam3 cung1 jap6 gaan1 fong4
